patch.value: Restore complete Rust coverage for the published oracle refresh

PR 181 at 1caff0a passes both Rust shards on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows. CI run 44297971605 merged both coverage shards and found 108 uncovered lines, 7 functions, 206 regions and 92 branches. Reproduce the merged report, identify the uncovered paths introduced or moved by this refresh, and add targeted tests to meet the existing 100 percent thresholds.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Preserved the existing coverage receipt and started reproducing the full instrumented oracle suite and four-dimension gate for PR 181.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Verified both original coverage profile manifests and used the report to isolate gaps in claim provenance, linked artifact notes, cursor delivery, context activity, and refusal rendering. Published SDK history and stale foreign-claim CLI cases pass. Validating remaining cases with the locked oracle and a fresh all-target branch coverage run.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The published and native note refusals agree on exit, error codes and unchanged artifacts. Existing option-scope and rendered-guidance differences are tracked in pm-rust-linked-note-diagnostics. The focused note refusal test passed.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Coverage map: src/mutation/claim_activity.rs:37,87,102,142,167 -> tests/support/claim_activity_differential.rs, covering corrupt streams, ownership provenance, history rewrites and restores. src/mutation.rs:599,1856,3495 -> credential-authors and skipped-claim mutation tests. src/collections.rs:845,871,940,1229 -> linked note recovery and full-history replacement cases in tests/search_collections_differential.rs. src/list_intent.rs:368,423 -> stale and over-budget projection tests. src/read_output.rs:37,51 -> malformed omission markers and cursor metadata tests. src/orientation_context.rs:1106 -> unknown-time activity control. src/main.rs:726,1323 -> post-close release and explicit or environment identity refusals. src/ownership.rs:237 and src/refusal.rs:464 -> authority boundaries and recovery redaction. src/toon_output.rs:334,456 -> per-group restore hints and sparse row grouping tests.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Formatting, locked all-target Clippy, changelog check, and both native coverage-union fixtures passed. The initial instrumented ownership target passed 60 cases. Its earlier credential fixture used a format flag absent from the scalar commands; the corrected case passed both the stable and instrumented targeted runs. The remaining targets use the two repository shard partitions and one common local profile set.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The local Node wrapper now preserves each harness case’s NODE_OPTIONS override. Both optional and required missing-tool controls and harness parity passed on the instrumented rerun.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The first complete local profile union had 20343 of 20354 lines, 2095 of 2095 functions, 33290 of 33312 regions and 4638 of 4650 branches. The final gaps identified a repeated linked-note policy validation and split SDK versus CLI coverage. A typed, validated note policy now reaches reconciliation directly, the SDK cases cover conflict replay and write projection, and close returns the release error through the same tested receipt path. Running the affected instrumented targets on the updated source mapping.

value.author: codex-sol

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Local merged quick coverage passes the unchanged four-dimension predicate using real current instrumented profiles: lines 20360/20360, functions 2096/2096, regions 33314/33314, branches 4648/4648.
